answer: The zephyr index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 719 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ledge. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the echo queue while honest agents promoted earlier still earns. A 108 account operation therefore ties up 34 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
